$comment: Generated registration-graph metadata. For each stable per-tag entry (`entry`), `registers` lists every <lr-*> tag that importing it defines as a side effect: its own tag plus any composed-child registration its registration entry pulls in transitively (e.g. lr-table.js also registers lr-empty/lr-pagination/lr-skeleton/lr-spinner). Run `pnpm run registration-graph` (scripts/generate-registration-graph.mjs) to refresh.
